latest_release.name: v4.6.4
latest_release.body:
> 4.6.4 is a security release. It fixes [eight advisories in Nuxt](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/security/advisories) and pulls in `nitropack` 2.13.6, which fixes [three more in Nitro](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/security/advisories). We recommend upgrading as soon as you can.

## ⚠️ Behaviour changes

These probably won't affect most apps, but it's worth flagging anyway:

1. **Error details in production.** When a page fails to render on the server, the error page and the payload now only carry message and data of errors you create with `createError`. Everything else is stripped.
2. **Dev server `Host` checks.** Webpack and rspack dev servers now reject requests with an unexpected `Host` header, as Vite already does. If you use a custom hostname or tunnel, you'll need to add it to the new `devServer.allowedHosts` option.
3. **`workspaceDir` detection.** When `workspaceDir` isn't set, Nuxt now only widens it past `rootDir` to an explicit workspace root or the closest git repository. 
4. **Nitropack cached routes.** `cache`, `swr` and `isr` route rules now only cache `GET` and `HEAD` requests, and no longer store responses that set a cookie or send `Cache-Control: private` or `no-store`. Wildcard `proxy` and `redirect` rules also reject requests whose resolved target would leave the rule's scope.
5. **Route rules and encoded slashes.** Route rules now match paths that contain encoded slashes, so `/api%2Fadmin` is covered by a `/api/**` rule.

## 👉 Changelog

[compare changes](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/compare/v4.6.3...v4.6.4)

### 🩹 Fixes

- **nitro,nuxt:** require unrouting 0.3.2 ([`768d21368`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/768d21368))
- **nitro:** preserve wildcard tails in case-insensitive route rules ([`bf31e4cd8`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/bf31e4cd8))
- **nitro:** require nitropack 2.13.6 ([`1b13c6981`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/1b13c6981))
- **nitro:** keep leading double slash in renderer request path ([`75c12c6fb`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/75c12c6fb))
- **nuxt:** use unambiguous encoding for island hash ([`6f1b93c64`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/6f1b93c64))
- **vite-server:** resolve wildcard redirect tails from the matched segments ([`1e7dfa6a7`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/1e7dfa6a7))
- **nuxt:** do not expose details of untrusted thrown errors ([`8c56b71e4`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/8c56b71e4))
- **nuxt:** strip trailing slashes in linear time ([`97424dd21`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/97424dd21))
- **nitro,webpack:** include hosts the CLI allows after loading the config ([`8c11d965d`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/8c11d965d))
- **webpack:** skip hot middleware for forbidden dev requests ([`3c9645326`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/3c9645326))
- **rspack,webpack:** reject unexpected Host headers in dev middleware ([`f8d64c9aa`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/f8d64c9aa))
- **schema,nitro,vite:** add `devServer.allowedHosts` ([`3e1c7964e`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/3e1c7964e))
- **nitro,nuxt:** match route rules for paths with encoded slashes ([`084396b10`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/084396b10))
- **schema:** only widen workspace dir to a declared workspace root ([`89d3306d1`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/89d3306d1))
- **nitro:** only trust `x-forwarded-proto` in when opted-in (#36818)
- **nitro:** stream the body read through a `nuxt/server` handler (#36817)
- **kit:** suggest the specific fix when loading falls back to jiti ([`24d75659d`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/24d75659d))
- **vite:** use a single type checker (#36774)
- **nitro,vite:** remove windows + virtual dev ssr css links after hydration (#36765)
- **nitro,vite:** dedupe dev css by module node (#36420)
- **nuxt:** avoid hoisting setup-only values from `definePageMeta` (#36751)
- **nuxt:** only match hydration modifiers after lazy prefix (#36750)
- **kit,nitro,nuxt:** make emitted tsconfig
